digest.component_or_area: CI checkout and tickets store initialization
propositions: Full clone of tickets store costs 1.04 GiB / 59s; partial clone with blob:none filter reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (~15x reduction).
rebar fetch operations occur post-clone; clone size leverage is the actions/checkout step, not rebar-side fetch flags.
P1 bug: when tickets fetch times out, rebar silently bootstraps an empty orphan store via worktree add, diverging from origin/tickets and causing all reads to return empty results.
blob:none partial clone is safe for rebar's access patterns including verify-identity and authorship resolution, which operate on tree-level diffs and read event/keyring bodies from the working tree.
Fail-open fallthrough to orphan bootstrap must be replaced with fail-closed behavior (non-zero exit, no orphan branch created) on any fetch failure.
merge.ours.driver must be set before blob:none filter is deployed to prevent silent 3-way text merge degradation of 18 MB .bridge_state JSON files during reconverge.
